 Cleburne County stops two-point conversion in third overtime, earns first semifinal berth since 2002. 
 This week’s games
 FRIDAY, Nov. 20 
 Class 3A quarterfinals 
Cleburne County 35, T.R. Miller 3 4, FINAL
 Class 1A quarterfinals 
Addison 35, Winterboro 22, FINAL
 Private Class A semifinals 
Westbrook Christian 36, Tuscaloosa Academy 16, FINAL
 By Joe Medley 
East Alabama Sports Today
 PIEDMONT — Cleburne County needed every play maker during its Class 3A quarterfinal against T.R. Miller on Friday, and every play maker came through.
 Camden Beam and Koby Hale stopped Kevin Henderson on a two-point conversion in the third overtime, and the fourth-ranked Tigers survived 35-34 to reach the state semifinals for the first time since 2002.
 Cleburne County (13-0) will play host to 10th-ranked Pleasant Grove on Nov. 27, with a berth in the state finals in Mobile on the line. Pleasant Grove beat third-ranked Bullock County 36-35.
 This story will be updated.
 T.R. Miller at Cleburne County updates
 –Kickoff 7 p.m.
–TRM wins toss, defers. Cleburne County will receive the opening kickoff.
 FIRST QUARTER 
–TRM converts a fourth-down pass while driving 99 yards, scoring on Kevin Henderson’s 2-yard Wildcat run at 1:21. Kevin Barragan’s PAT is good. TRM 7, H E FLIN 0 
 SECOND QUARTER 
–After recovering a Heflin fumble and benefitting from a personal foul penalty, TRM scores on Marquice English’s 4-yard run at 10:02. PAT is good. TRM 14, H E FLIN 0 
 –Jaylen Baker lobs a 32-yard TD pass to Lyric Ware at 1.0. Erick Peredes’ PAT is good. TRM 14, H E FLIN 7 
 THIRD QUARTER 
–On fourth and goal at the 1, Alijah Ware plunges in for the TD at 3:14. PAT is good. TRM 14, H E FLIN 14 
 FOURTH QUARTER 
–Cade Shubert r e turns an interception from the Heflin 35 to the TRM 32 with 1:33 to play.
 –Peredes lined up for a 40-yard field goal on fourth down and 1 with 28 seconds left. After a TRM timeout, Heflin go e s for it and gets stopp e d,
 FIRST OVERTIME 
 –After Baker’s mad scramble sets up fourth and goal from the 1, Silas Hunt scores. PAT is good. H E FLIN 21, TRM 14 
 –Henderson keeps for a 2-yard TD. TRM lines up for 2-pt converion, but called for delay. Barragan hits the PAT. H E FLIN 21, TRM 21 
 S E COND OVERTIME 
 –English up the middle for a 10-yard TD. PAT is good. TRM 28, HEFLIN 21 
 –Baker keeps for a 10-yard TD. PAT is good. TRM 28, HEFLIN 28 
 THIRD OVERTIME 
 –Alijah Ware 2-yard TD. PAT is good. HEFLIN 35 , TRM 28 
 –English 10-yard TD run. Timeout, TRM. Timeout Heflin. Heflin stops English (Camd e n Beam, Koby Hale). HEFLIN 35 , TRM 3 4
